The financial stability report states that the domestic Instant Payments Platform uses ISO 20022. Annex 3 is broad correspondent and AML guidance, not an XML implementation guide. Its statement about MT9xx retirement should not be reused as a verified Swift deadline because payment and reporting migrations differ.
